task_description: Activate the MCP tool group "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps) and call exactly ONE tool: "get_place_details". Goal: fetch detailed information for the top-rated cafe within walking distance of the Metropolitan Museum of Art (1000 5th Ave, New York, NY). Use a place ID or query for a highly-rated cafe near the Met (e.g. a cafe inside/adjacent to the Met such as the Met Dining / Cafe at the Met, or a top-rated nearby cafe). Return the cafe NAME, average RATING (and review count if present), ADDRESS, and the PLACE ID exactly as returned by the tool. Do NOT call any other tools (no search, no directions, no distance matrix). If get_place_details errors or times out, state clearly that the call failed/was skipped and report the error message verbatim; do not retry more than once and do not invent results. If the tool group or tool is unavailable, say so explicitly.

Activate the MCP tool group "laplace_context7" (server: Context7) and call exactly ONE tool: "resolve-library-id". Goal: attempt to resolve a cafe near the Metropolitan Museum of Art into a known library / public documentation identifier. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: the previous step's Google Maps call ("get_place_details") was SKIPPED because the laplace_google_maps tool group was unavailable, so we have NO place ID and NO verified cafe name from any tool output. Therefore pass a query derived from the user's request text only — e.g. query "Metropolitan Museum of Art cafe accessibility" (and/or "Cafe at the Met"). Report verbatim whatever the tool returns (matched library IDs / names / descriptions), or the exact error/timeout message if the call fails. Do NOT call any other tools. If the "laplace_context7" tool group or "resolve-library-id" tool is unavailable in this environment, state that explicitly. Do not invent results and do not retry more than once.
